entities.name: Saint-Jean-Baptiste (Ampoigné)
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Saint-Jean-Baptiste Church is a church in Ampoigné, Mayenne, France. It was built in the 12th century by the abbey of Saint-Florent de Saumur. It is a Romanesque style building remodeled several times retaining the aesthetics from the 12th and 15th centuries.
